title: Count comparable infested shoots
action: Inspect tender flush on representative trees at the same interval and record life stage, infested shoots, beneficial insects, and previous product use.
limitations: Presence alone is not a numeric treatment threshold in the current record.

title: Check drainage and protect the collar
action: Record standing water, basin condition, trunk-base injury, and canopy decline before choosing a response.
limitations: This demonstration action does not replace disease confirmation or a source-backed treatment plan.

title: Confirm the cause before correction
action: Record which leaves are affected, field distribution, irrigation conditions, and recent inputs; obtain local soil or leaf-test guidance before applying a nutrient product.

title: Identify the weed before choosing a method
action: Record the species or clear photographs, location, crop age, and whether weeds are competing in tree basins or between rows.
limitations: No herbicide or mechanical program is verified in this first reference.
